document_info.title: ESPEN guidelines on nutrition in cancer patients

summary_of_recommendations.recommendation: All cancer patients should be screened regularly for the risk or the presence of malnutrition[cite: 20, 630].
Energy and substrate requirements should be met by offering nutritional interventions in a step-wise manner from counseling to parenteral nutrition, except in end-of-life care[cite: 21, 631].
Nutritional care should always be accompanied by exercise training[cite: 23, 633].
In subjects with normal kidney function, protein intake up to and above 2 g/kg/d is considered safe[cite: 134].
Nutritional interventions should only be implemented after considering prognosis, expected benefit on quality of life, and the burden associated with care[cite: 207].
